Franklin Bi on X: "Our latest report on the State of Tokenization is out today! 

Last time, we asked how much of today's tokenized market is stuck in the "newspaper-on-a-website" phase. This time, we asked what comes after tokenization? How do tokenized assets become tradable markets with broad investor participation?

Our Q2 research covers 671 tokenized assets ($330B+) with amazing work by @sui414 @0xallyzach. We updated our Tokenization Progress Index (TPI) across issuance & redemption, transferability, and composability.

This edition adds new dimensions: onchain trading and ownership data. These help depict the current state of liquidity, trading volumes, and overall participation in tokenized assets.

We also cover key Q3 developments, including @RobinhoodApp Chain's launch and the Clarity Act. 

Takeaway #1: Open assets are winning the battle for liquidity. Among tokenized assets of $10M+ value, the open / freely transferable ones made up 41% in value, but processed 99.8% of spot trading.

Takeaway #2: Equity demand is arriving mostly through derivatives, mainly perpetuals. June equity perp volume hit $67.8B, ~16x the $4.2B of tokenized-equity spot volume.

Takeaway #3: Liquidity means something different for each product. Yield funds need dependable redemption. Tokenized stocks need deep liquidity. Collateral needs reliable valuation & liquidation.

Despite the CLARITY Act's delay, the momentum behind tokenization can't be stopped. The Great Onchain Migration marches forward, from putting assets onchain to building new markets around them.

Here's the full report link: 
https://t.co/xuthedEd3Z"
